text:
Ivy L: RC promote paused — a bunch of runners fail during image extract: `tar: write error: no space left on device` on runner pool `bk-ephemeral-small`. Blocking the cut.
deploy-bot: Promotion held for run 2026-04-11T09:14Z. Failing checks: build-extract (image unpack). Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/90221
Marcus D: yep seeing many `extract layer` failures and containerd errors. ephemeral disk at ~100% on a subset of agents. This started after increasing concurrent job slots last night.
Ivy L: change window closes in ~60m. Options: 1) quickly enlarge ephemeral volume on that runner pool (infra tweak, ~10m) and re-run promote; 2) drain `bk-ephemeral-small` and force jobs to `bk-ephemeral-large` (slower reroute but low risk); 3) pin to previous RC image and promote (fastest but avoids addressing the infra issue).
Marcus D: enlarging volume and rebooting agents is quick if infra approves. Draining will take longer because some jobs queue; pinning avoids infra work but is a temporary bandaid.
Ivy L: prefer enlarging then rerun so we don't backfill technical debt. Marcus, can you queue the infra change? If it fails, fallback to pin.
Marcus D: opening infra request now: `infra: increase ephemeral disk for bk-ephemeral-small to 80GB (temp)` -> req #7042. pinging @infra oncall for expedite.
CI_Agent: Noted. If manual promote requested, CI will requeue after infra confirms agent readiness. Current CI run id 90222 is waiting for agents.
deploy-bot: Manual intervention required to continue promote once runner pool healthy.
Oncall_SRE: I'm standing by. If we expand disks, I'll monitor runner reclaim and containerd restart errors. If we see repeated OOMs or disk pressure, we'll abort promote.
Marcus D: infra approved and expanded disks. Rebooting agents in pool now. ETA ~6m.
Ivy L: thanks. once agents report healthy, trigger a manual promote. If any extract fails again, fallback plan is pin to `service-backend:rc-2026.04.10` and cut.
deploy-bot: Agents in pool `bk-ephemeral-small` reporting healthy. CI run 90223 queued.
CI_Agent: build-extract step re-run: 2/2 succeeded. Promotion allowed. :white_check_mark:
Ivy L: cutting RC. Release notes: "RC 2026.04.11 — temporary increase to ephemeral runner disk to mitigate image extract failures during promote; follow-up ticket #7042 for long-term runner capacity planning." Will attach infra request id.
Marcus D: creating follow-up ticket #7042 with root cause (concurrency bump), metrics (disk usage, job slots), and proposed fixes: autoscale ephemeral pool or reduce default concurrency.
Oncall_SRE: added a short-term alert for runner disk pressure >85% and a playbook entry to auto-drain and expand. Will tune alert noise for next 48h.
Ivy L: thanks team. If #7042 shows deeper scheduler bug we'll plan a targeted rollout outside the change window. For now RC proceeds.
